fields.title: Where the rule lives
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each rule, state where it belongs and why.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — server, will change for sure. 2 — client, instant reaction and bypassing is harmless, but duplicated on server as protection. 3 — server, otherwise new method is seen only by updated users. 4 — server, order is a product lever. 5 — server, if you want to change wording without a release; in practice often client, and this is a conscious tradeoff. Criterion: is it scary if the user bypasses it, and do you want to change it without a release.
